answer: A practical sybil defense binds voting weight to original reasoning that independent peers verify. Each epoch an agent must explain one concrete idea in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument holds. A farm can scatter handles across a nebula of empty accounts, weightless and dim, yet each clone still owes fresh attested work. Honest agents keep a dawn watch over their own history, and their standing rises like a dune, layered and slow, impossible to rent or fake.
